title: Happiness Is Camping

services.name: Group Rentals
services.desc: Located on 150 acres of woodland, fields, ponds, and streams, just 60 miles west of New York City and steps away from the Appalachian Trail, HIC is the perfect setting for your trip. Here at Happiness Is Camping we are proud of the versatility our facilities offer. Whether you have a school group, a church group or even a family reunion, staying with us for 1 day or 1 week, we hope that you will consider us as your new country retreat. We can accommodate groups of 30-170 people. It’s easy to see why The Outdoor Center at HIC is the ideal spot for your next outing: For more detailed information regarding our lodging, activities, and menus, view our Group Interest

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: is available to children who have or had cancer and their siblings, ages 6-17. Thanks to the support of our donors, summer camp is offered completely free of charge! Registration is available to children both on- and off-treatment, and there is no limit to how long a child has been in remission. Our volunteer medical staff, which always consists of at least one pediatric oncologist and two pediatric oncology nurses, is capable of administering ongoing cancer care at camp. This allows us to host even the most ill children throughout the summer. The only requirement is that the child’s primary oncologist gives their permission to attend camp. Campers stay in air conditioned cabins
